name: Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{RTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: On every coordinate projection, recursive teaching dimension dominates no-clashing teaching dimension. Maximizing both sides over projections proves the claim.
proof_source: Corollary cor:projected-rtd-low-projected-nctd in the LaTeX survey.
witness_verification: On the full $n$-cube, $\mathrm{RTD}^{p}=n$ whereas $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=\lceil n/2\rceil$, so the gap is unbounded.
